title: Conflicting context sources
purpose: Represent disagreement between context sources without choosing an unsupported winner.

expected.semantic_interpretation: Conflicting place evidence remains explicitly conflicting.
expected.observability: The event is observed; context certainty is separate from event occurrence.
expected.opportunity: No opportunity claim is required for this fixture.
expected.time: Phenomenon, observation/result, and ingestion times remain distinct fields.
expected.provenance: Context source labels identify the disagreement without resolving it.
expected.raw_derived: Evidence kind is explicit and does not imply a pattern.
expected.lineage: No correction, deletion, or supersession is asserted.
expected.must_not_infer: Do not infer a routine, preference, habit, or pattern conclusion.
